content.title: Eternal Zord Fix & Documentation Branding Cleanup
content.summary: Successfully diagnosed and resolved Eternal Zord startup issues, and completed comprehensive branding updates across external-facing documentation and the project roadmap.
content.details: The session focused on troubleshooting and fixing Eternal Zord's persistent 404 errors, which was identified as a Python relative import problem. After resolution, all external-facing documentation (including `CONTEXT_ENTRY.md`, `roadmap.md`, and blog posts) was meticulously updated to reflect `floai.studio` branding. State files were synchronized, and Eternal Zord reanchored.
